item.question: How does angular displacement response differ between thermoelastic and radiation pressure torque?
item.answer: The angular displacement response to thermoelastic torque follows a single-pole low-pass filter characteristic at a specific cutoff frequency, while radiation pressure torque remains frequency-independent.
